area-level.offset.note: area level = 64 + tier: T15 = 79, T16 = 80. T16 drops only by Vaal-corrupting a T15 (S21, S22)

area-level.max.note: above 80, Irradiated gives +1 and a corrupted node +1; one source says an Overseer tablet also gives +1 (L)

mods.extra-damage-as-element.note: percent of damage as extra fire, cold, lightning or chaos; highest tier, poe2db's current values
